shared_elements: horizontal band or register of marks
justification: The strongest overlap is that both surfaces include schematic, glyph-like linear signs arranged partly in horizontal bands, with some oval/circular forms among the markings. The major difference is that B is dominated by a large anthropomorphic/face-like figure with paired round eyes and a curved mouth or chest motif, while A is dominated by an inscription-like panel of repeated signs without the same figural scheme.
